articles.title: Buckingham Palace says Prince Harry will not stay there despite his team announcing he would
articles.description: Royal sources say the Duke of Sussex had not responded to the offer of accommodation at a Royal residence by the deadline last week.

articles.title: Pizza Express held inquiry into Andrew's Woking claim
articles.description: BBC Newsnight has learnt the pizza chain held an internal investigation into the former prince's assertion that he had visited its Woking branch.

articles.title: Wegovy weight loss pill now available in UK - here's what you need to know
articles.description: The once-a-day pill, from the makers of the Wegovy weight-loss jab, can now be bought privately in UK pharmacies.

articles.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
articles.description: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.
